module up_counter (
    input wire reset_n,
    input wire enable,
    input wire clk,
    output wire done
);

reg [7:0] cntInc;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset_n) begin
        cntInc <= 8'b0;
    end else if (enable) begin
        cntInc <= cntInc + 1'b1;
    end
end

assign done = (cntInc == 8'd32);

endmodule
